# Global Water Law Dataset — Research Dashboard

> Interactive dashboard for a comparative dataset of 83,596 water law judicial decisions
> across Brazil, Canada, and the Netherlands (2016-2026), testing the "Legal Last Mile"
> theory of administrative exclusion from sanitation access.

This page is a client-rendered chart dashboard; its substantive data and documentation
live in the GitHub repository, not on this site. Its `<head>` carries a static meta
description and schema.org JSON-LD (Dataset and Thesis types) for anything that can't
execute its JavaScript.

## Full project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jrklaus8/water-law-dataset): the canonical source
  for the dataset, scrapers, jurimetric coding engine, and full `llms.txt` index at its
  root, including an agentified, AI-queryable version of the 2023 UNIARP master's thesis
  that originated this project's Brazil-Ontario comparison, and a dated, sourced record of
  which of that thesis's claims still hold today.
- [Preliminary research PDF](The_Legal_Last_Mile_Research.pdf): the full "Legal Last Mile" write-up.
- [DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19836413): formal citation record for the dataset.
